senses_operations_manifest.description: Describe Senses Phase 8 backend surfaces, dependency requirements, frontend, and runtime routing work.

senses_reference_manifest.description: Report the Senses reference surface. Capture reference search remains deferred after Phase 8 routing.

senses_view_filter.description: Read the current Senses workspace-shared frontend view state. Requires an authenticated Maverick actor.

senses_set_view_filter.description: Set Senses tab, query, and status filters. Requires workspace-admin authority because the state is workspace-shared.

senses_set_custom_view.description: Set a curated Senses custom view. Requires workspace-admin authority because the state is workspace-shared.

senses_clear_custom_view.description: Return Senses to normal browsing. Requires workspace-admin authority because the state is workspace-shared.
